subject: Goal Framework Proposal: Exec endorsement & QBR packet prep
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Goal Framework Proposal: Exec endorsement & QBR packet prep

Team —

Attached is the first draft of the goal framework for the upcoming quarter ("goal_framework_v1.pptx") plus a QBR readiness checklist I pulled together (qbr_readiness_checklist.xlsx). High level ask: I need executive endorsement on the objectives and the top 3 key results for each objective so we can lock decks and customer comms by EOD Wednesday.

Quick context:
- Objective A: Improve inference cost-efficiency for hosted API customers
  - KR1: 20% reduction in per-token GPU cost for 95th percentile latency workloads
  - KR2: Deploy prefix/KV caching on 3 major model routes
  - KR3: Reduced aborted requests by 15% via fallback policies
- Objective B: Strengthen enterprise adoption signals (SLA/Private security posture)
  - KR1: Two pilot Private deployments with SOC-compatible configurations
  - KR2: Console: token-level cost breakdown GA

Specific asks: review the KRs and measurement definitions on slides 6–9, flag anything that blocks sign-off, and confirm if we can use the conservative targets or if you want us to push more aggressive numbers. If you have minor edits, add inline comments on the Drive deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gv-goal-framework-QBR

I propose a brief alignment call (30 min) tomorrow at 11:00–11:30am PT to surface any objections before we finalize. If you cannot make it, please reply with a signed-off note or provide redlines by Tue EOD.

Attachments: goal_framework_v1.pptx (presentation), qbr_readiness_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Product Ops — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Goal Framework Proposal: Exec endorsement & QBR packet prep

Thanks Mina — I skimmed slides 6–9 and this is directionally correct. Two quick notes:
- KR2 for Objective A: prefer wording "Enable KV/prefix caching on top 3 production routes by EOW" to make rollout scope explicit.
- Suggest tightening KR3 metric to "reduce aborted requests from client-side timeouts by 15%" (so it's measurable).

I attached a one-page with inline comments (goal_frame_comments.pdf). I can join the 11am alignment call tomorrow.

-Marcus
Director, Infrastructure
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Attachment: goal_frame_comments.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Goal Framework Proposal: Exec endorsement & QBR packet prep

On Mon, Jun 28, 2026 at 9:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached is the first draft of the goal framework for the upcoming quarter...

Appreciate the draft, Mina. A couple of clarification requests before I sign off:
- Measurement windows: are per-token cost reductions measured quarter-over-quarter or on a rolling 30-day baseline? Please make this explicit in the KR notes.
- Customer-impact framing: for Objective B KR2 (Console cost breakdown), we should call out the MVP telemetry fields so Sales can demonstrate savings to customers during the QBR.

Also: please include a short "what success looks like" blurb for each objective (one sentence) so the field teams can present it cleanly during QBR panels. If you can incorporate these small edits into v2, I can sign off ASAP.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Brightline Workshops <workshops@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Goal Framework v2 + redlines summary (please sign-off)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick comments. I've incorporated Marcus's wording adjustments and Laura's measurement/"what success looks like" bullets into v2. Major changes are summarized in redlines_summary.txt; the new deck is attached as goal_framework_v2.pptx. Highlights:
- Clarified measurement windows: KRs reference a rolling 30-day baseline with snapshot at quarter start for planning.
- Objective A KR2: now reads "Enable KV/prefix caching on top 3 production routes by EOW (canary + staged rollout)."
- Added one-line success statements under each objective for QBR talking points.
- QBR packet: draft agenda and slide ownership mappings added (slides 15–18).

Proposed next steps:
1) Please review v2 and either reply "signed" or provide further redlines by Thu 12:00pm PT.
2) If signed, Stephanie will circulate the finalized QBR packet to comms and Sales; Rishi/Laura to confirm panel speakers.
3) QBR rehearsal scheduled: Fri 07/02, 10:00–11:30am PT (calendar placeholder).

Attachments: goal_framework_v2.pptx, redlines_summary.txt
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gv-goal-framework-QBR

Mina
